namespace_policy: One authoritative visual asset source per image. Atlas stores a location/scene reference to asset_id and source receipt, never duplicates the underlying image or promotes generated concept art to primary character authority.

newer_parallel_thread.relationship: Separate ongoing photo asset library thread mentioned by Founder; exact new image registry, URI scheme and storage system not verifiably present in current repo readback

workflows.atlas_3d: Reference an eligible image to a stable LOC/CAND/POST handle as concept or inspected source; never use photo as proof of coordinates, distances or historic existence
workflows.memo_os: Reference image by source asset_id and page/week provenance; cannot silently overwrite released folios or add private proof images to public build
workflows.novel_os: Bind an optional atmospheric reference to a scene or twelve owner POVs only after source-safe period, status and portrayal checks
workflows.postseason: Use island photo references as speculative design until island geography/Last Field/technology acceptance; preserve protected memorial, contender-only, and Losers Beach access boundaries

integrity_gate: Manifest is read only and externally versioned; never regenerate or overwrite it in Atlas
Every attached media path is repo-root-contained and SHA256 matches its declared source if bytes are available
Character source morphologies and current visual conflicts continue to be enforced by existing canon rules
Public visibility blocked if independent status, privacy or consent is unknown
No new duplicate photo folders under world/data or docs/visual generated by Atlas
cross_pr_reference: PR324 consumer handoff only; PR253 remains authoritative for its library and should evolve in its own branch
